name: blink-code-builder
description: Authors Blink automations as YAML from natural-language prompts, validates them against your workspace's action catalog, and saves them as drafts in your Blink workspace. Calls the Blink controller HTTP API directly.

blink_user_api_key.title: Blink user API key
blink_user_api_key.description: Your blink user API key (sent as BLINK-API-KEY header)

blink_pack_id.title: Blink pack ID (optional)
blink_pack_id.description: Optional: blink pack ID to save automations into. Leave blank to auto-create/look up per run.
